exact.潮水灭了灯: The tide put the lamps out
exact.两根能互相看见的柱不能同时立着。收起灯笼要花一潮，并记一次挪灯。: Two posts that see each other cannot both hold a lamp. Picking one up spends a tide and counts as a lift.
exact.能互相看见的两根柱不能同时立。先立照亮水洼最多的那根。: Two posts that see each other cannot both stand. Place the post that lights the most new pools.
exact.潮不够把立错的灯都收回来。一次挪灯比两只省下的灯笼更贵。: There is not enough tide to undo a bad post. One lift costs more than two saved lamps.
exact.把本局哪一根柱挡住了真正照亮水洼的位置写进你自己的 memory。只把这些当作这: Write which post blocked the one that actually lights the pools into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
